entries.text: "The Edel! A scumbag like you\nwill never be forgiven!!"
"Ugh! Is he my equal, or better?!"
"Damn, I've been had?!\nHaah, this is it!"
"Gwaaah!! This life of Gandal's,\nwill soon come to an end..."
"Only a rail king can do this...!"
"See now, a glimpse of my power?"
"Even if Innocent falls,\nSibe Rail is immortal!"
"Dodge the Law, not Sibe Rail's tracks!"
"This world's order is\nupheld by my railway!"
"If you've come to this\nworld, then follow my rails!"
"The rails go on, wherever I desire!"
"Making me do this...\nNot like you, Cynthia."
"Fools who can't use\narms dare challenge me!"
"You lost to Cynthia,\nyet you'd beat me?"
"Even with a good Overman,\nthat's just not enough."
"Guh...! I've gone and hurt my back...!"
"Where's my guard?! Protect me at once!"
"You'd beat me and go on with Exodus!?"
"S-stop! I'll cut taxes\nand send fresh food!"
"Here we go, show you Lujana spirit!"
"What! The fight is not over yet!"
"You think I'll let you have it?"
"Gah! But if it comes\nto that, I'll charge!"
"Whoa!? Did I take a direct hit!?"
"Guh... the Lujana Militia\nwon't retreat from this!"
"Hole in the armor? I'll\ncover it with guts!"
"Think this'll stop us? Not a chance!"
"Tch, at this rate,\nSochie's gonna laugh at me."
"The Lu Janna suicide\nsquad- this is nothing!"
"I'm used to dolls like these, too!"
"At this rate, you\ncouldn't even beat Sochie!"
"So this is all a Moonrace can do?"
"If I use that thing\nthey call a barrier...!"
"Noise on the monitor...!\nDamn, can't see ahead!"
"Tech gap or not, I won't lose!"
"Show me the power of the White Doll!"
"This is what I can do now...!"
"I'll use this power to end the war!"
"I just do what I can and what I want!"
"The feelings entrusted to me...\nI will carry them to the future!"
"For the world I want to protect!"
"Watch their moves, and this is easy!"
"I won't let you scratch this machine!"
"Damn! I have no time for you!"
"Why can't you see\nthis fight is futile?!"
"I've got a shield! This is nothing!"
"Gah! Landing a hit on the Freedom!"
"It took my armor?! But I'm still in!"
"A pilot who can handle that unit...!"
"Athrun, I can't afford to fall either!"
"Even without hope, I\nfight! That's why I'm here!"
"I won't fall until this war is over!!"
"Not yet! I still have things to do!!"
"So this is the machine's...\nPilot's true power!"
"All I can do is this much..."
"To go where I want\nto go... I fight now!"
"This time I'll find the right answer!"
"The will in this suit...\nI won't waste it!"
"The hopes in Freedom...\nI won't waste them!"
"You... Just who the hell are you!?"
"Your ego only brings\nmisery to the world!"
"Edel Bernal! This world is not yours!"
"This huge frame... Only\nthe cockpit's a target?"
"For ideals... for belief,\nso many died! But you!"
"You who see women as tools, what?!"
"Same as you! I have my own\nreason not to back down!"
"I won't let you harm the Archangel!"
"What we want is not a managed future!"
"Future's made by us,\nnot fate or genes!"
"I won't let the world or\nyou be wrapped in darkness!"
"Why... why did it come to this!"
"I, Gym Ghingnham,\nwill send you to your grave!"
"To live is to fight! Win and survive!"
"I'll destroy everything with Turn X\nand usher in a new age!"
"2,500 years of drills\nshow our clan's might!"
"This is what a Shining Finger is!!"
"This Turn X is amazing! Just what you'd\nexpect from Turn A's big brother!!"
"I'll gather data on your vital signs\nas I send you to God's kingdom!"
"Oh, not bad. Then how about this!?"
"This Gym Ghingnham will take you on"
"T-this Gym Ghingnham...\nis to be sealed away!?"
"D-damn you!! To dare do\nthis to Gym Ghingnham!"
"Yes, that fighting instinct\nis what humans need!"
"To die together as the system dictates...\nDoesn't that sound interesting?!"
"Interesting! Just as expected\nof that accursed mobile suit... Gundam!"
"I've taken all your energy...\nLike Gendarme's power!"
"You think that can take down\na Turn-type mobile suit!?"
"Hmph! The Gundam name is no lie..."
"Ho... Not bad. Want to\njoin the Ghingnham Corps?"
"Less than that, and you\ncan't be Turn X's brother!"
"Even with a Gundam, you can't\nbring down this Ghingnham!"
"What's wrong...? That's\nno way for a Newtype."
"Beg for life! Out of that machine!"
"You fools who know\nnot of Black History!"
"For the likes of you,\ncapturing Turn X is impossible!"
"Even a Gundam, at best,\nis just this capable!"
"Then you're below a\ntool of war, Newtype!"
"And you're supposed to be a machine\nrevived from Black History?! Pathetic!"
"You dare enter my reach!\nThat I acknowledge!"
"Sweatson! With a performance like\nthat, I can't entrust a unit to you!"
"That's it, machine angel!\nA true Shadow Angel slayer!"
"With the boss taken down,\nI must set an example!"
"For what I have done! You\nmust be prepared, yes?"
"Hahahaha! I've seen the\ndemon power in you!!"
"Use up your Turn power,\nEarth might be saved!"
"For turn type, this\nTurn X alone is enough!"
"Turn X is Turn A's\nwatchdog, Laura Rolla!"
"Turn A, root of Black History!\nShow me your power!"
"Shall we celebrate Black History's return\ntogether, you mobile suit called Gundam?!"
"Even a Gundam\ncannot beat this Turn X!"
"Now, fight without shame\nto the name of Gundam!"
"Do you realize who you're up against,\nHarry Ord?!"
"Newtypes are nothing but\ntools of war, after all!"
"Even a Newtype cannot block my path!"
"You lot have no right\nto live in this era!"
"You think you can win with that junk?!"
"The likes of the Turn A\nare not needed in our era!!"
"Strike down the idol Dianna\nSoreil and it's all over!"
"The Big! Turn X seems to\nbear a grudge against you!"
"What's wrong? Turn X's glad to meet!"
"Turn X wants to repay\n12,000 years' debt!"
"Turn X has functions like this too!"
"This Grah will send you to hell!"
"Behold the power of my Hyakki robot!"
"Just one... I'll take\nit out with Doran!"
"Alright, I'll crush you in one go!"
"I'll make this place\nyour grave, no mistake!"
"No matter what brats\npilot them, I'll win!"
"I'll roast you like a young bird!"
"Sorry, but Dad's got\nmore style than you!"
"You're a fine man. Not\nas fine as pops, though!"
"A girl challenging me?\nTen years too soon!"
"This little brat! I'll\nteach you the worth of age!"
"Bad luck for you.\nGetting targeted by ME!"
"Because of you, my dad died! Dad...!"
"Ah ha ha! You fell for it!"
"Can't take it... want to be a bird..."
"Tch, of all the luck!\nMe, pushed this far?"
"Jiron! Don't think I'll\ngo to Papa so easily!"
"Not bad, are you? With that cute face!"
"You did it now! I\nwon't let this slide!"
"What's the matter? Is\nthat how you're the star?"
"For a round-face, you did well, Jiron!"
"You lack the years to match my level!"
"I can't do anything\nshameful in this getup!"
"See that! The power of my love!"
"Are you that afraid\nto face me head-on?"
"If you die, I wonder what\nfaces those brats will make!"
"Laugh if you want! A\nwoman's grudge never dies!"
"Don't get cocky! You're\nworse than a girl!"
"Aquarion is our hope! I won't let you!"
"An attack like this won't hit me!"
"Tch! You won't have it your way!"
"On par with us...?\nA worthy foe indeed!"
"Ugh! I can't take this\nattack many more times!"
"Damn it! We cannot\nlose... We cannot lose!!"
"We've trained for this\nday...! We can't lose!"
"If I can't beat Cherubim,\nthen this war..."
"I'll cover you. Fall back, don't push!"
"Ugh, I must use the M-Fly system!"
"Apolly, back off! I'll take the rest"
"I'll hit them with wave after wave!"
"So it's a woman...! It\nshows in your attack!"
"Is that meant to be\nthe Titans' symbol...?"
"When will you learn? Earth\nand colonies are one!"
"Your ego dies with the old order!"
"That Mobile Suit's craft,\nyou can't bear its weight!"
"Is that Reccoa Londe in that machine!?"
"The Edel... your twisted\ndesires crush the world!"
"A golden suit... Can't\nlet my guard down!"
"Unforgivable. To try and\ncontrol us from the shadows..."
"The old won't shape the new age!"
"Let me cleanse that\nsin with my own hands!"
"Haman, I just won't let\nthe world go astray!"
"Can't you see? Feds become a new Zabi!"
"Guh! But as long as it\nmoves, it's not over!"
"Nice aim... Can't let my guard down!"
"Haman, I won't let you have your way!"
"I don't want to kill you, but!"
"To over the Overman, this is how!"
"Love and courage are words!\nKnow that and it's Over Heat!!"
"See that! I can do it when I have to!"
"Now I can do the reverse\nof Overfreeze...!!"
"If I can't surpass the\nOverdevil, I'm no King!"
"Think you can keep this up forever?!"
"If you'd stayed hidden,\nyou'd have been safe!"
"There's no recovery time! I can move!"
"With the Flying Ring,\nit can shield me!"
"I can't let you fall\nbefore I pay you back!"
"Team battle role: do your own duty!"
"Caught up in their pace!?\nThis isn't like me!"
"Gotcha! I set you up for that!"
"You can't keep up with\nKing Gainer's speed!"
"Enemies like these, I've\nfought countless in games!"
"I can see it! No - I see it!"
"If it doesn't hit, any\nOverman's attack is nothing!"
"I feel a chill...! Then,\nI can't afford to get hit!"
"That attack... had I not\nseen it, I'd be done!"
"The Scorer's too slow!\nI dodged that one!"
"We can do it! The core spec\nisn't adjusted to this place!"
"We're Overmen, you know!\nWe've got Photon Mats!"
"Meeya once sealed it away!\nDon't act like you're doomed!"
"Damn! Against an Overman,\nI shouldn't be losing!"
"An Overskill like\nthis?! It's an ice devil!"
"Turn type or not, don't get cocky!"
"No mercy, huh? I've got plans too!"
"Not dying here! I don't wanna die!"
"My good-luck charm for when I'm\nlosing... I'm an animal... I'm an animal...!"
"Gah! If I take another\none, I won't just pass out!"
"Damn! Calm down, find\na gap, or I'm dead!"
"This won't work! Then\nwhat... what should I do!?"
"I won't lose to Sibe\nRail! Absolutely not!"
"Is it the specs? So\nlittle real combat!"
"If I lose to an Overman,\nCynthia will scold me!"
"I have Over Skills too!\nI'm not out of this yet!"
"Stop it, Cynthia! Finish it in a game!"
"Is it because they change\nlight reflection?! Damn, hit!"
"Even the Photon Mat Ring\ncan be Over Frozen...!"
"If you bear the resolve\nto be serious too...!"
"Wake up, Cynthia! Not all of\nyou lost to the ice demon!"
"Edel! We are not pawns in your game!"
"If he's part of Black History too!"
"I'm King Gainer too!\nEven against an Overman!"
"They come back again! Those\nOvermen of Saint Reagan!"
"You're the last one! Here\nI go! KING GAIINAAAR!!"
"I must take war tools from Cynthia!"
"Is this what you people call justice!?"
"Why come this far?\nPeople of St. Reagan!"
"The Black History must\nnever be repeated again!"
"Don't fall for the Morph!\nStrike one weak point!"
"Can't win if your\nthoughts show... no way!"
"Siberia is a precious place\ntoo! I won't let aliens take it!"
"I won't accept this end...!\nBut I don't want to!"
"With Sara and Cynthia,\nI can do anything!"
"Outdated! You shame Sara!\nI'm not in Gauli's squad!"
"If you freeze, you won't get hurt."
"The world nor you see your folly."
"Think you can hit me, Freeze King?"
"How foolish... This is\nwhy I hate the living"
"Don't you get it? It won't work"
"Is this your best? If\nso, I'm disappointed."
"Even Gain's attacks won't work on me."
"Ah ha ha ha ha! This is reality, Gain!"
"So you plan to kill me,\nwho's in your way, right?!"
"Dead-on aim - they're\nseriously trying to kill me!"
"So you'd kill your\nbuddy like that, huh!"
"You're serious now...!\nGuess I'm done for then!"
"No joke! I won't just die like this!"
"Overfreeze is too slow! Their\nresistance is not fading...!"
"Damn it all!! Why can't I beat Gain!"
"Machine Angel... you should never\nhave risen from the Black History."
"You used your position\nto do as you pleased!"
"Hiding behind adult excuses\nis no model for kids."
"You can't beat me! After all,\nI may be Satan's own child!"
"You were the best at using me..."
"A repeater can't get what I do, right?"
"Just a kid, don't act\nlike you know it all!"
"That's how you use men, isn't it?"
"Soft terrain makes it hard to aim...!"
"Let your eyes adjust to the dark...!"
"Where are you looking!\nYour opponent is me!"
"Clear line of fire! Taking the shot!"
"Take the mark of the\nBlack Southern Cross!"
"Move aside! Let me show you how!"
"Is this all you can do\nwith that Overman, kid!?"
"If I can't save a lady, Black\nSouthern Cross is shamed!"
"Tch! Need to get closer than this...!"
"I just can't help doing cool stuff, me"
"An attack like that,\nno pride in dodging it"
"No way I get hit that easy!"
"A hundred years of the\nsame! Brother Asuham Boone!"
"I know better than to\ntake that attack head-on."
"Undressing a girl, be\nthis gentle, got it?"
"Do you have the luxury to test me?"
"Ugh! Got hit! I'm\nout of practice, huh?"
"Asuham, struggle all you\nlike, this is your limit!"
"Arm of Brunhilde protect\nme? Damage is light..."
"Going easy on me for old times' sake?"
"I know the real terror of that."
"Tch, dodging is all I can do!"
"That hurt! Got a grudge against me?"
"Good! If I avoid direct hits,\nOverdevil stands a chance!"
"Gainer, have you frozen\nall the way to your core!?"
"Guh! Is he reading my\nmoves from the other side?!"
"Just move! Hold on a bit more...!"
"So Saint Reagan wasn't just for show!"
"Damn it all! Black\nSouthern Cross falls too!"
"You came through Sibe\nRail to get me, Asuham?"
"Your time is up, your turn is over...!"
"Asuham! Why not just\naim for me alone?!"
"I won't fall for weird sound tricks!"
"The Edel! I can't go along\nwith your twisted dreams...!"
"The Edel! I\'ll mark you\nwith the Southern Cross too!"
"A knight saving the princess\nchallenges fair and square!"
"Your quick draw vs. my\nsniping... which wins?"
"Employer is Sibe Rail...\nDon't need more work!"
"I won't give up the starring role,\nKid Hola, buddy!"
"A single blow is the least mercy...!"
"Brats won't listen,\nso I'll beat it in!"
"An Overman can kill people\ntoo! Do you understand that!"
"You tried hard, but this is it!"
"Right gun, good! And left too, yeah!"
"AutoGun's all in how you use it!"
"HAHAHA! This gets me\none step to rank 46!"
"Now... not a thief, but\nI'll take something."
"Hehehe, let's tack on\nthree extra kill marks!"
"I'll show you I can\nuse the options freely!"
"Shut up and wait for my punch!"
"My chance to shine, won't waste it!"
"Damn it! Helping city rats like you!"
"Leave it to the guard\nsquad, Operations Chief!"
"If the boss goes down,\nwhat about my pay!?"
"Save the President,\nget pay and a raise!"
"No holding back! Pour it all in!"
"Oh, you can leave it to me!"
"So much ammo spent! If\nI miss, it's a loss!"
"Hey now, isn't that a bit too simple?"
"It's antique to begin,\nso this is all, right?"
"Whoa!? Those Yapan\nguys are aiming at us!?"
"This was over from the start, ma'am"
"Hand over that Overman!\nYou don't deserve it!"
"Oh ho! A breaker's defying Sibe Rail!"
"I can't let you take it all!"
"I got scratched! I'll\ndemand apology and pay!"
"Cut it out! My machine ain't cheap!"
"Not yet! This won't\nerase my Sibe Rail love!"
"Eeeek! How did it come to this!?"
"Gweh! I can't escape the\nBlack Southern Cross, huh!"
"Don't get cocky! Not\neven for the boss!"
"There's no way I can\ndodge an Overman's attack!"
"How am I supposed to\nbeat an Overskill?!"
"With Mexbrute's Overskill,\nno one's a threat to us!"
"Alright! A chance to earn Blue Stones!"
"Don't think you can push around hicks!"
"Boss Lady, die for us!\nOr become my bride!?"
"You just have to be my special bonus!"
"Bring back your head,\nand I'll get promoted!"
"Gain Bijou!? Where do I even strike!"
"This is the end for Japan's lot!"
"Beat you and I'm the lead here!"
"Hahaha, this is the end for you too!"
"If we fail to take you out,\nBig Bro will chew us out!"
"Leave the rest to me! ...Not.\nCatchin' my show-off habit?"
"I'm going for broke! Bring\nit on, I'll take you on!"
"Whoa! Sorry, bro! I let my guard down!"
"Hey bro! These guys are for real!"
"Tch! If I run from this,\nmy big bro will punch me!"
"Ow ow! You don't have to\nget so serious about it!"
"Come on, engine, start!\nStart! I said start, damn you!"
"Big bro! Nobody told me about this!"
"Instead of beard, I'll play with you!"
"Hahaha! Lord Corin\nNander will be your foe!"
"Where the hell did the Gundam go?!"
"I ain't tough enough to\nbeat Earth's gravity!"
"You little Gundam... Not bad at all!"
"That's it!\nI expect at least that much from you!"
"My battle years are on another level!"
"Calling that a Gundam is an insult!"
"Treat her like a girl\nand she dizzies you!"
"With that much power,\ngo home and sleep!"
"I'll give you credit for that guts!"
"A Gundam should be\nbetter than that, right!?"
"Get closer if you want a hit!"
"You too... you too are\na mustache Gundam!?"
"I won't forgive anyone who\nwrecks the princess's heaven!"
"End this fast, or the\nBlack History returns!"
"Warriors' way of life, pass it on!"
"I won't forgive anyone who\nmakes the princess sad!!"
"Don't look down on us for\nflying patchwork machines!"
"For the princess,\ntime to pitch in once more!!"
"Even the Turn A should\nopen a new era!!"
"I'll take point! Don't you lag behind!"
"Yeah, yeah! You gotta\ngive me that much!"
"I won't let you end the world!"
"Gym Ghingnham! You won't get past me!"
"I too am a Golem user! Here I go!"
"You will become an even\nbigger threat later!"
"This is how you use the\nUnder Golem's options!"
"Once the Under Golem's\nMach Band Shaker hits!"
"Step back, guards!\nDon't get in my way!"
"Jaboli! Show me you can\nuse the options freely!"
"Sibe Rail's job isn't\nto cause trouble, is it!"
"Good with dolls, but\npiloting... not so much!"
"You think that getaway speed\nwill keep you alive? Damn it!"
"Ha, aiming at me? What a fool!"
"Whoa!? A fluke, or are you toying me!?"
"A Walker Machine\ncan't keep up with me!"
"It hits, but not a killing blow."
"B-being toyed with?!\nBy Kizz Munt's trump card?!"
"Saint Reagan won't fall\nto something like this!"
"Gah! Gain Bijou, I won't forgive you!"
"N-no good! Not with that weird move!"
"Hold on! Just a bit more! Hang on!"
"If I just find shelter,\nthere's still a chance!"
"I'm not dead yet... I have to survive!"
"Is the silver Overman's\npower abnormal? This much!"
"Are we to be played by a\nmere girl to this extent!?"
"A lowly breaker made it this far!"
"Black Southern Cross,\nI'll take you down myself!"
"As long as we live, no Exodus!"
"Feel even a fraction of\nAlan and Christine's pain!"
"That goes to Earth! No matter what!!"
"What's the point of\nliving in a false world?"
"Why do you laugh in\na false world? You!"
"Guh! But I can't afford to stop now!"
"I won't die till I\nsee it fall to Earth!"
"Not yet! We still have work to do!"
"My life is already given!\nBut there's still much to do!"
"Hold out a bit longer!\nOur dream is almost here!"
"Then I'll ram my mech into them!"
"Guh! Arms, legs! Use your final power!"
"You failed to grasp\nmy position, it seems."
"Damn! If only those had not appeared!"
"Even at the cost of my life,\nI'll see this mission through...!"
"The life of Lacus Clyne,\nmust be taken at all costs!"
"Lost sight of them?! Find them now!!"
"Don't flinch! This\nwon't sink a ZAFT ship!"
"Turn around! Use the debris as cover!"
"PLANT's future is at\nstake! I can't lose!"
"This is bad! Keep them away from us!"
"By force we must show,\nor ZAFT won't stop!"
"Not yet! That tragedy\nmust never happen again!"
"I must not sink! For our hope!"
"Guh! If we sink here, PLANT will...!"
"Damn...! So this is all LOGOS's plan?!"
"Nice hit, I'll grant you... that's it!"
"This machine won't fall to that blow!"
"For PLANT's sake, I cannot fall here!"
"The Destiny Plan builds a new world!"
"If I can fight back, I must!"
"Don't you get it yet? It's useless!"
"He won't aim for the\ncockpit, I know that!"
"You'd stop war with that?\nDon't make me laugh!"
"I have the data... I can dodge!"
"I won't fight my kin... is that it?"
"Blue Cosmos is no enemy of ours!"
"Must guard the chair!\nNo time to waver!"
"I can't lose! For the Chair and PLANT!"
"So that's how it spreads!\nYou too continue the hate!"
"No good! We can't beat FAITH at all!"
"Not yet! I won't bow to Earth Forces!"
"How many times will\nyou betray us, Athrun?!"
"To think I'd fight\na Second Stage unit!"
"That rig can't turn on a dime!"
"You're not the only ones with Gundams!"
"ZAFT machine or not, if it's a Gundam!"
"Down a Gundam, and I'm an ace!"
"We won't let you have your way!"
"I doubt this will do\nmuch... Borot Punch!!"
"I can do it too, you know!"
"I can do this much too, so there!"
"I won't let you scratch Diana A!"
"Sorry, but I'm tougher than I look!"
"Diana A is fine with this much!"
"I won't rely on Koji\nfor something like this!"
"You'll pay for that!\nYou won't forget this!"
"W-Well, even the Mazinger\nmight be in danger...!"
"I'm a member of Gauli Squad too!"
"One more time... I can do it!"
"Let's see how Panther Gun holds up!"
"BB, let's see how much you can take!"
"I have to pay back what I owe!"
"Don't get cocky just cause\nI'm watching, Gainer!"
"Gain, good work! I'll handle the rest!"
"I saw Bello's hard work, you know!"
"Cynthia, nice! I can do it too!"
"Don't fuss over me!\nI'm not a kid anymore!"
"If I'm doing this,\nit's now...! Here I go!"
"Pathetic attack...! No\nway I'm hit by that!"
"You think you can confuse me, huh!"
"With this speed, I shouldn't\nbe caught up to...!"
"City folk only train on\nstationary targets, huh?"
"Like I'd be fooled by that song!"
"Just a hit... It's just a hit!"
"That Overman sure is on its game!"
"Is torturing a girl the Central way!?"
"Knowing Cynthia,\nthis probably isn't even full strength...!"
"I-I knew it... I don't\nwant to fight like this...!"
"A bit too rough! Rough guys get hated!"
"Hey! What do you think you're doing!?"
"So rough! That's why I hate Sibe Rail!"
"I knew you were all\nstrong, but still...!"
"Had enough now!? Go\nback to the center!"
"Listen to me, Cynthia! In\nreal combat, people die!"
"Damn it! I won't let\nyou Overfreeze me!"
"If all you did was for your\nown greed, I won't forgive!"
"Ms. Edel! So many people\nbelieved in you, you know!"
"Don't know your title,\nbut your taste stinks!"
"Kizz Munt! If you're the\nPresident, act more grown up!"
"If this can end it all...!\nLet's do it, Sara Kodama!"
"Tolls and taxes, that's\nall you care about!"
"Just cause it's Saint Regan,\nnot everything is allowed!!"
"No matter what you become,\nI won't give up...!"
"If you must resent someone,\nresent the one who hired you...!"
"Why... why did it have\nto come to this...!"
"Your ways kill people! Get\nthat through your head!"
"Here we go, Gainer, Cynthia!\nLet's settle this here!"
"I'll back you! If this kills it!"
"Got it...! The world to come\ndoesn't need the likes of you!"
"What's this?! Am I being pushed back?!"
"I'm in this now! Let's do it!"
"Enemy's still in\nrange! What do we do!?"
"Since they hit us,\nwe have to hit back!"
"Freeden advances as is!\nWe'll hold them off!"
"I'll take it here! Pull back now!"
"At this rate, we won't hold out long!!"
"Out of ammo... and we're\nlow on supplies too..."
"No! Out of ammo at\na time like this...!"
"This spot's no good! Freeden, move up!"
"Toniya, send Kid to the hit area!"
"Gah...! If we lose the Freeden,\nI can't face the Captain...!"
"No time for tears! Those\nfree, put out fires!"
"Kamille! I won't let you\ninterfere with Lord Paptimus!"
